## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(mapview)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Read Data

```{r}
ag_2015 <- st_read(here("data/Agricultural_Land_Use_2015_Baseline.geojson"))
```

```{r}
ag_2020 <- st_read(here("data/Agricultural_Land_Use_2020_Update.geojson"))
```

# Make a map

```{r}
mapview(ag_2015, zcol = "cropcatego")
```

```{r}
unique(ag_2015$cropcatego)
```

R color brewer can enhance this

Distibution Of Acreage

```{r}
ggplot(ag_2015, aes(x = acreage)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~island, scales = "free_y")
```

Questions:

Did we add/lose ag land acreage between 2015 and 2020?

```{r}
sum_2015_acreage <- sum(ag_2015$acreage)
sum_2020_acreage<- sum(ag_2020$acreage)

sum_2020_acreage - sum_2015_acreage
```
